edges.reason: Owner list parameter drives the initialization of the owners list and ownersMap.
Required signature count parameter is validated and stored by init.
chainId parameter is hashed into the DOMAIN_SEPARATOR.
lastAdd local tracks the previous owner to enforce ascending unique order.
Loop index iterates over the owners list during validation.
init writes the owner array into contract storage.
init marks every owner address as true in ownersMap.
init stores the required signature threshold.
init computes and stores the EIP712 DOMAIN_SEPARATOR.
init flips the initialized flag to prevent re-initialization.
DOMAIN_SEPARATOR is part of the EIP712 hash recomputed in submit.
requiredSignatures bounds the signature verification loop, controlling authorization strength.
Current nonce is included in the transaction input hash.
tx.origin is embedded in the signed payload, creating an origin-based authorization dependency.
submit increments the nonce (nonce = nonce + 1) after verification.
Signature v array elements are passed into safeRecover.
Signature r array elements are passed into safeRecover.
Signature s array elements are passed into safeRecover.
Hash parameter is forwarded to the ecrecover precompile.
v parameter is validated then used in ecrecover.
r parameter is used in ecrecover.
s parameter is range-checked for malleability then used in ecrecover.
safeRecover delegates signature recovery to the ecrecover precompile.
submit calls safeRecover for every signature slot.
Loop index selects the current signature triple passed to safeRecover.
recovered address is the output of safeRecover.
Recovered signer must be present in ownersMap to authorize execution.
ownersMap is read by submit to validate every recovered signer.
totalHash is prefixed with the Ethereum signed message prefix.
prefixedHash is the message hash recovered against each signature.
Caller-controlled destination determines the external call target.
Caller-controlled value is forwarded to the external call.
Caller-controlled data is forwarded as calldata to the external call.
submit executes an arbitrary external call after updating the nonce.
The external call hands control to an untrusted callee that may re-enter the contract.
Success flag of the external call selects between Execution and ExecutionFailure events.
msg.sender is emitted as the deposit source.
msg.sender is returned by _msgSender and used for owner comparisons.
msg.sender is emitted in the AdminAdded event.
msg.sender is checked by the onlyAdministrator modifier guarding createLiteSig.
owner() returns the stored _owner address.
onlyOwner compares _owner with the caller before allowing execution.
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership.
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership.
onlyOwner gates addAdmin.
onlyOwner gates removeAdmin.
isAdministrator reads the administrators mapping.
onlyAdministrator relies on isAdministrator for the caller check.
onlyAdministrator restricts createLiteSig to whitelisted administrators.
addAdmin sets the administrators entry to true.
removeAdmin sets the administrators entry to false.
transferOwnership overwrites _owner with the new owner.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to the zero address.
liteSigLogicAddress is encoded into the proxy deploy code.
Caller-supplied salt determines the create2 deployed address.
Proxy constructor writes the logic address into PROXIABLE_SLOT.
contractLogic parameter is validated and stored by the constructor.
Constructor uses assembly sstore to persist the logic address.
PROXIABLE_SLOT is loaded as the delegatecall target in the fallback.
The fallback executes the delegatecall to the logic contract.
delegatecall hands execution to external code in the caller context, enabling re-entry.
createLiteSig performs the create2 deployment of the proxy clone.
Factory calls init on the freshly deployed LiteSig contract.
Owner list is forwarded from the factory call to the new contract init.
Required signature count is forwarded to the new contract init.
chainId is forwarded to the new contract init.
deployedAddress is the output of create2 and is returned by the factory.
Proxy creation code is used to build the deployment payload.
deployCode payload is passed to the create2 opcode.
Logic address parameter is stored by the factory constructor.

normalization_plan.reason: init._owners is an input parameter used only by LiteSig.init.
init._requiredSignatures is consumed solely by LiteSig.init.
init.chainId is consumed solely by LiteSig.init when building the domain separator.
init.lastAdd is a temporary local inside LiteSig.init.
init.i is the loop counter of LiteSig.init.
safeRecover.hash is an argument of safeRecover feeding ecrecover.
safeRecover.v is an argument of safeRecover feeding ecrecover.
safeRecover.r is an argument of safeRecover feeding ecrecover.
safeRecover.s is an argument of safeRecover feeding ecrecover.
submit.sigV elements are consumed by safeRecover.
submit.sigR elements are consumed by safeRecover.
submit.sigS elements are consumed by safeRecover.
submit.destination directly controls the unsafe external call target.
submit.value is forwarded to the unsafe external call.
submit.data becomes the calldata of the unsafe external call.
submit.recovered is the returned signer of safeRecover.
submit.totalHash is the EIP712 hash recovered in safeRecover.
submit.prefixedHash is the message hash passed to safeRecover.
submit.success is the result of the unsafe external call.
isAdministrator.addressToTest is the argument of the administrator lookup.
addAdmin.adminToAdd is the argument written by addAdmin.
removeAdmin.adminToRemove is the argument written by removeAdmin.
transferOwnership.newOwner is the argument written by transferOwnership.
Proxy constructor parameter is stored by the constructor assembly.
createLiteSig.salt is the direct argument of the create2 opcode.
createLiteSig._owners is forwarded only by createLiteSig.
createLiteSig._requiredSignatures is forwarded only by createLiteSig.
createLiteSig.chainId is forwarded only by createLiteSig.
createLiteSig.deployedAddress is the local result of the create2 deployment.
createLiteSig.code is a local used to build the deployment payload.
createLiteSig.deployCode is a local passed to the create2 opcode.
Factory constructor logic-address parameter is consumed only by that constructor.
submit.i indexes the signature arrays consumed by safeRecover.
